change.summary: The dedicated server restores the established furnace recipe that smelts one rotten flesh into one leather.

before.reason: The recipe line was accidentally deleted while unrelated transport recipes were consolidated on 2026-10-14.

modifiers.notes: The existing recipe ID and conversion are restored unchanged, so recipe synchronization is sufficient for existing clients.

rationale.purpose: Restore the previously approved rotten flesh to leather furnace conversion without changing its balance or requiring a client update.
rationale.decision_source: User report and request for a live recipe reload on 2026-11-01
rationale.user_requested: Rotten flesh must smelt into leather again and the recipe must be applied through a recipe reload.
rationale.implementation_choice: Restore the exact historical KubeJS recipe ID and conversion on the dedicated server, then reload KubeJS recipes without restarting MineRENT.

introduced.summary: Restored the established rotten flesh to leather smelting recipe after its accidental deletion.

history.summary: A broad recipe consolidation removed the established recipe alongside unrelated Immersive Aircraft recipe code.
Restored the exact historical recipe on the dedicated-server KubeJS surface for a live reload.

notes: No item, serializer, registry, packet, model, texture or language resource changes.
Existing Forge clients receive the restored recipe through normal server recipe synchronization.
unresolved: Player acceptance on MineRENT remains pending after the live KubeJS recipe reload.
